name: ogive
description: Rocket design copilot over OpenRocket: judge every change, prove it by simulation.
long_description: Ogive drives your local OpenRocket 24.12 headless. Read and edit .ork designs, fly their simulations, judge them against safety rules (stability through the ascent, rod speed, fin flutter, recovery, motor curve sanity, stale results) and compare versions. Every number carries its provenance: backend, seed and the file's sha256. Edits always write a new file. Advisory only: OpenRocket and RASAero II sign off on real flights. Needs OpenRocket 24.12 installed (Windows).

openrocket_home.title: OpenRocket folder
openrocket_home.description: Leave empty to look where OpenRocket 24.12 installs (C:\Program Files\OpenRocket, /Applications/OpenRocket.app). Otherwise pick the folder it's in.

workspace.title: Rocket designs folder
workspace.description: Ogive reads and writes .ork files only inside this folder.

reference_simulation.title: Reference simulation
reference_simulation.description: Simulation to fly when a request doesn't name one, if the design has it (e.g. your team's standard sim). Empty: each design's first simulation.

tools.name: inspect_design
tools.description: Components, editable fields, motors and stored sims of an .ork.

tools.name: run_simulation
tools.description: Fly a simulation in OpenRocket; seeded, with optional time series.

tools.name: static_stability
tools.description: CG, CP and calibers as OpenRocket's design view computes them.

tools.name: judge_design
tools.description: Fly and apply the safety rules; every verdict names its source.

tools.name: edit_design
tools.description: Change numeric fields; always saves a new file.

tools.name: set_motor
tools.description: Swap the motor by designation; the curve is chosen by integrated impulse and verified in OpenRocket.

tools.name: render_design
tools.description: To-scale side view from OpenRocket's model: PNG to show, SVG to keep.

tools.name: view_design
tools.description: Interactive 3D view in the chat (MCP Apps), drawn from OpenRocket's model.

tools.name: view_versions
tools.description: Timeline of design versions in 3D: ghost overlay, changed parts, metric deltas.

tools.name: replay_flight
tools.description: Replay a simulated flight in 3D: cameras, events, Mach 1; simulation data, not footage.

tools.name: add_mass_component
tools.description: Add nose weight or ballast; always saves a new file.

tools.name: compare_designs
tools.description: Field diff plus both designs judged on the same sim and seed.

tools.name: optimize_fins_and_nose_weight
tools.description: Grid sweep, judged; lightest passing design and Pareto front.
